input_identity_limit: The sought McCormick/Brooks 1996 report and a separately discovered 1998 CMMT(A)140 document must retain distinct identities. Neither citation nor a similar report title establishes grade304 or actual-foil coverage.
compact_evidence_policy: Explicit checksum whitelist only; new request outcomes, source/assessment records, public association, exact command prefix and correction lineage. No older scientific artifact closure.
excluded_raw_inputs: Cached PDF, HTML bodies, OCR text, page/native imagery, raw web-search response and landing-inspection visible-text dumps remain outside repository/archive; only exact original paths, hashes, sizes and short identity findings are retained.
discovered_report_metadata_conflict: Preserve the1998 PDF cover author A McCormick/title Liquid Metals separately from landing author N J McCormick/singular metal. Do not silently reconcile either mismatch or substitute this report for sought1996ref8.
archive_verification: Actual compressed member bytes, safe unique paths, manifest and folder bytes, public source/patch, original input hashes and final code pins. Scientific and source-acquisition programs are never imported or rerun.
command_snapshot_policy: Only commands.jsonl may grow after its immutable complete-record byte-prefix snapshot; every other declared copied original remains strict.
completion_policy: Locked unexpired same-owner lease; verify actual archive before status mutation. Preserve the complete saved queue and prior scientific fields/history, append only this source assessment, then release lease.
